_comment: Directories the Verify Now agent may send a code for. send=agent: the submitter agent runs the send (default). send=script: a deterministic script in verify_send.py (only after an agent run confirmed it and the PR cites that run). channels: sms, phone-call. A Directory or channel not listed here fails no_playbook with 0 site loads. vault_items: tenant -> Citations collection item name.
